def stamp(ts: int) -> str:
    """Format a Unix timestamp in seconds as HH:MM:SS (UTC, 24 hours, zero padded)."""
    pre ts >= 0
    post out.char_count() == 8
    ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
    ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
    ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
    ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
    secs = ts % 86400
    h = secs // 3600
    m = (secs % 3600) // 60
    s = secs % 60
    return f"{pad2(h)}:{pad2(m)}:{pad2(s)}"

def pad2(n: int) -> str:
    """Zero pad a number from 0 to 99 to two digits."""
    pre n >= 0
    ex pad2(5) == "05"
    ex pad2(42) == "42"
    if n < 10:
        return f"0{n}"
    return f"{n}"
